About.title: About Us
About.paragraph1: We are a church with more than 47 years of history, and we remain committed to the faithful preaching of God's Word for salvation and the edification of the body of Christ.
About.paragraph2: Our church was founded with the purpose of being a community where families can grow in the grace and knowledge of the Lord Jesus Christ, while holding firmly to biblical principles and sound doctrine.
About.paragraph3: Here, you and your family are welcome to worship, learn, and serve together, as we seek to honor God in everything we do.
About.imageAlt: Facade of the Fundamental Baptist Church

Schedule.title: Our Schedule
Schedule.subtitle: We offer several times of fellowship, worship, and biblical teaching. You are welcome at all of them!
Schedule.footnote: Hymns and songs are subject to change.
